title: Paul McCartney live: Hallam FM Arena, Sheffield | 2003
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Hallam FM Arena in Sheffield, England, on 5 April 2003.

It was the sixth date of the Back In The World Tour, which lasted for 33 dates between March and June 2003.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney returned to the Hallam FM Arena later in the tour on May 29 2003.
